title: Office Phrasal Verbs
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Los phrasal verbs son fundamentales en el inglés real de negocios. Ahora dominas los más usados en el entorno corporativo.

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Phrasal Verbs de Oficina

parts.visual: Un phrasal verb es un verbo + preposición/adverbio que forma un significado nuevo: Set up a meeting (Organizar una reunión). Follow up (Hacer seguimiento). Hand in (Entregar). Log in (Iniciar sesión).
parts.audio: A phrasal verb is a verb plus a preposition or adverb that creates a new meaning: Set up a meeting, Follow up, Hand in, Log in.

parts.visual: Más phrasal verbs: Put off (Postponer). Fill in (Rellenar). Call off (Cancelar). Carry out (Llevar a cabo). Look into (Investigar). Back up (Hacer copia de seguridad).
parts.audio: More phrasal verbs: Put off means postpone. Fill in means complete a form. Call off means cancel. Carry out means execute. Look into means investigate. Back up means make a backup.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el phrasal verb correcto según el contexto.

questions.question: Can you ____ a meeting for Monday? (Organizar).
I will ____ with you tomorrow. (Hacer seguimiento).
Please ____ the form. (Rellenar).
questions.explanation: Fill in (UK) / Fill out (US) = rellenar un formulario.

questions.question: We need to ____ the audit next week. (Llevar a cabo).
questions.explanation: Carry out = llevar a cabo / realizar.

questions.question: I need to ____ to the system. (Iniciar sesión).
The meeting is ____ to next month. (Postponida).
Please ____ your files. (Hacer copia de seguridad).
questions.explanation: Back up = hacer copia de seguridad.

questions.question: Can you ____ the sales data? (Poner en la pantalla / mostrar).
questions.explanation: Bring up = traer a la mesa / mostrar.

questions.question: We ____ a new strategy. (Pusimos en práctica).
She ____ the meeting. (Presidió/Dirigió).
questions.explanation: Chair a meeting = presidir / dirigir una reunión.

questions.question: Could you ____ the proposal? (Revisar/Mirar).
questions.explanation: Look over = revisar / echar un vistazo.

questions.question: I will ____ your message. (Transmitir/Pasar).
questions.explanation: Pass on = transmitir / pasar un mensaje.

questions.question: I need to ____ to the system. (Iniciar sesión).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Can you set up a meeting for Monday?
options: Can you set up a meeting for Monday?
Can she set up a meeting for Monday?
Could you set up a meeting for Monday?
Can you arrange a meeting for Monday?
questions.correct_answer: Can you set up a meeting for Monday?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I will follow up with you tomorrow.
options: I will follow up with you tomorrow.
She will follow up with you tomorrow.
I will follow up with her tomorrow.
I will get back to you tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: I will follow up with you tomorrow.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Please hand in your report by Friday.
options: Please hand in your report by Friday.
Please send your report by Friday.
Please hand in the report by Friday.
Please hand in your report on Friday.
questions.correct_answer: Please hand in your report by Friday.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I need to log in to the system.
options: I need to log in to the system.
She needs to log in to the system.
I need to log out of the system.
I need to log in the system.
questions.correct_answer: I need to log in to the system.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The meeting is put off to next month.
options: The meeting is put off to next month.
The meeting is put off until next month.
A meeting is put off to next month.
The meeting was put off to next month.
questions.correct_answer: The meeting is put off to next month.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We should look into the issue.
options: We should look into the issue.
They should look into the issue.
We need to look into the issue.
questions.correct_answer: We should look into the issue.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: Could you back up your files?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We came up with a new strategy.
options: We came up with a new strategy.
They came up with a new strategy.
We came out with a new strategy.
questions.correct_answer: We came up with a new strategy.
